messages:
Alex R: Heads-up — planning rollout of v2.4.0 to prod tomorrow 10:00 PST. Looking for a deployer + smoke owner. Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% over ~45m with 10m observation windows. Cohorts: NA-west primary, small EU subset. Any volunteers? Also need rollback readiness.
Mira C: I can take deployer. I'll be on-call during the window and will post progress here.
Sasha: I can own smoke checks. Smoke checklist I'll run: 1) /health, 2) latency p50/p95 under 150/400ms, 3) errors <0.5%, 4) KV cache hit rate. I'll run `./scripts/smoke.sh prod -w`.
Tom B: +1 on GPU mem guard — abort if GPU mem >85% for >2min. Also, what's the rollback exact flow?
Alex R: Rollback flow: immediate abort of rollout, revert service image to tag v2.3.9, route traffic back, invalidate KV caches if needed. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollbacks — follow the quick revert section. Also enable automatic fallback to smaller model variant if latency SLOs break.
Ops-Bot: Reminder: scheduled deploy window: 2026-03-18 10:00 PST - 11:00 PST. Please confirm final owners.
Mira C: Confirmed. Will start with canary batch at 10:00: 1% (~100 req/min) then ramp to 5% at 10:10 if metrics stable. I'll handle the rollout command and watch the dashboard.
Sasha: I'll prepare a 10-query prompt set and run eval baseline at 09:45. Posting results here once done. Will stop the rollout immediately if any regressions.
Tom B: I'm OOO most of the day but reachable on slack for emergency rollback. @Alex R tag me if you need an engineered revert.
Alex R: Thanks. @Mira please ensure DB migrations are backward compatible — no blocking schema locks. For rollback commands: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/ri-inference --to-revision=...` and `routingctl route set default v2.3.9` are in the runbook.
Mira C: Got it — will verify migrations and add a quick preflight script to the release job. Will also check GPU mem alert thresholds in infra. :thumbsup: 
Sasha: I'll post the smoke pass/fail summary in this thread immediately after each window.
Alex R: Great. I'll update the calendar invite with owners and link the runbook. If no objections by EOD, we roll tomorrow 10:00. Thanks all.
